verdict.rationale: Navan has the building blocks for coding spend. It offers corporate and connected card transactions, receipt scanning, and custom-field management through the API. Spend can also be broken down by vendor and category, and policy flags help focus review. However, nothing in the evidence shows that transactions are automatically coded with merchant, category, memo and receipt at the moment of spend, or that this feeds a month-end close. Missing for 10: evidence of real-time or automatic coding at swipe time, memo capture, auto-categorization, accounting/ERP sync or close workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
